at.description: When the party wrote the entry, by its own statement. No rule reads order from it

ground.description: Why the seller declined. Core terms: `availability` | `exclusivity` | `terms`, the grounds of § 4.3.2. Absent on any other entry. A receiver that doesn't know a term still reads the entry as a `decline`

idempotency_key.description: Buyer-generated, unique per `commit`, opaque, and scoped to one buyer and seller pair. The seller MUST NOT interpret it (§ 5.6.1)

line_item_ids.description: The line items the entry names. MUST be non-empty

record_digest.description: Of the binding record for the line items in `line_item_ids[]` (§ 4.1.1)

role.description: `commitment` | `acceptance` | `withdrawal` | `decline`. It says what the entry does, and it implies the party

version.description: The `version` of the record the digest was computed over. `version` is outside the binding record, so the entry binds it

certainty.description: `forecast` | `reservable`. `forecast`: the seller's estimate of the quantity. `reservable`: the quantity the seller says it can reserve for `window`. MUST be `forecast` when the line item's `delivery_type` (§ 5.9) is `non_guaranteed`

granularity.description: The bucket `quantity` counts per, within `window`. Absent: `quantity` is the total over `window`

quantity.description: How many. It can be fractional where the unit is, such as `rating_points` per `day`

unit.description: What `quantity` counts. Core terms: the `unit` terms of § 5.6.5, and `slots_per_loop` (as the § 5.2.4 key) | `unit_periods` (one unit for one period, such as a board for a 4-week cycle). A receiver that doesn't know a term can't compare the figure, and still reads the line item

window.description: The dates `quantity` covers. On a read (§ 3.3) or a decline (§ 5.6.1), the flight the buyer sent

excluded.description: The buyer's write: option ids of options whose `excludable` is `true`, disjoint from the seller audiences in effect. `max_select` does not count them

selected.description: The buyer's choice, by option id. It is the complete set in effect and replaces `included[]`.

seat_owner.description: The legal entity that owns the seats. Absent: the `buyer`

seats.description: The buyer's seats on the deal, as the Deals API 1.0 `wseat`

selected.description: The buyer's choice, by option id. It is the complete set in effect and replaces `included[]`.

value.description: The buyer's value, between the bounds inclusive.

selected.description: The buyer's choice, by option id. It is the complete set in effect and replaces `included[]`.

cancelled_share.description: The share of the remaining commitment cancelled, up to the `max_share` that applies

option_id.description: The `id` of the option in effect that the notice exercises

requested_effective_at.description: The effective date the buyer asks for

dated_shares.description: Dates with their own `max_share`. Outside every entry's `window`, the top-level `max_share` applies

fees.description: The fee, by how long before the reference date notice arrives. MUST be non-empty

max_share.description: Cancellable share of the remaining commitment. `0`: non-cancellable

notice_duration.description: Time from notice received to the earliest effective date: `P14D` is 14 days, `P0D` immediate

notice_reference.description: The date `before_reference` counts to. Core terms: `flight` (default) | `install_date`. `flight`: `commitment.flight.start`. `install_date`: the posting or install date. No key in the record holds that date, so a fee that counts to it can't be computed from the record

CancellationPolicySelection.description: A field the buyer sets by choosing options from the set the seller declares. `included[]` names the options in the base rate, `selected[]` the buyer's choice, which replaces it, and `deltas` the price of each option outside `included[]`, each by option id.

deltas.description: The price of an option outside `included[]`, keyed by option id. An option with no entry has no delta.

included.description: The options in the base rate, by option id.

max_select.description: The most options that may be in effect.

selected.description: The buyer's choice, by option id. It is the complete set in effect and replaces `included[]`.

writes.description: The buyer's writes (§ 3.4), keyed by each `line_item_id` that `entry.line_item_ids[]` names

availability.description: The figures that `decline` states, keyed by `line_item_id`. They are not part of the entry

entries.description: The buyer's `commitment` entry, then each matching `acceptance`, `decline`, or `withdrawal` entry written after it in `assent[]`

advertisers.description: Whom the spend is for. It holds at least one entry

amount.description: The figure committed: an `Amount` when `basis` is `spend`, otherwise a whole number of the entry's units (§ 5.6.5)

derived_units.description: The committed units, as § 5.6.5 derives them, whether or not this key is written. A written value is a copy, outside the record (§ 4.1.1); where it differs, the § 5.6.5 result applies

pricing_id.description: The entry the buyer commits under

amount.description: The figure committed: an `Amount` when `basis` is `spend`, otherwise a whole number of the entry's units (§ 5.6.5)

earliest_start.description: Informative: the earliest `commitment.flight.start` the seller expects

latest_end.description: Informative: the latest `commitment.flight.end` the seller expects

action_type.description: The kind of action counted, such as `shop.example:purchase`. This version lists no core terms

attribution_window.description: How long after exposure an action counts

demographic.description: The rated demographic, such as `ratings.example:adults_25_54`. Its definition states whether co-viewers and impressions of unknown age count, or says `unknown`. This version lists no core terms

rate_unit.description: `hour` | `day` | `week`. The unit the rate buys, counted in elapsed units

view_fraction.description: The fraction of the creative played that makes a view. Absent when `view_s` is present

view_s.description: Seconds played that make a view. Absent when `view_fraction` is present

viewability_standard.description: The viewability standard that counts a unit. Core term: `mrc`, the MRC guidelines that `viewable_rate` cites (§ 5.7.1)

CostParametersActionType.description: No core terms are listed yet, so every term is namespaced.

CostParametersDemographic.description: No core terms are listed yet, so every term is namespaced.

max_share.description: Cancellable share of the remaining commitment when this entry applies

window.description: The dates it covers. An option's windows don't overlap

impression_multiplier.description: What turns a play into impressions. A line item that counts only plays needs none

partial_play_credit.description: What a display on fewer than `min_screens_per_play` screens counts. Core terms: `none` (no play) | `pro_rata` (screens played ÷ `min_screens_per_play`)

play_tolerance_ms.description: How far short of its full duration a play may end and still count

proof_of_performance.description: Who logs the plays and what the buyer receives

categories.description: `taxonomy` per AdCOM 1.0 List: Category Taxonomies. An id covers its descendants

scope.description: `category` | `sole`. `category`: no other advertiser in `categories`. `sole`: no other advertiser

separation.description: Where the term holds. Core terms: `inventory` (all of this line item) | `page` (each page) | `pod` (each ad pod) | `stream` (each content stream an ad server fills) | `episode` (each podcast episode) | `loop` (each DOOH screen's loop) | `location` (each venue or site of this line item's properties, static or digital) | `paid_zone` (the part of each venue or site of this line item's properties past its paid entry, such as inside a station's fare gates)

window.description: The dates the term holds, only where they fall inside `commitment.flight`. Default: the whole flight. With no overlap, the term holds on no date and the option's deltas still count (§ 5.6)

ExclusivitySelection.description: A field the buyer sets by choosing options from the set the seller declares. `included[]` names the options in the base rate, `selected[]` the buyer's choice, which replaces it, and `deltas` the price of each option outside `included[]`, each by option id.

deltas.description: The price of an option outside `included[]`, keyed by option id. An option with no entry has no delta.

included.description: The options in the base rate, by option id.

max_select.description: The most options that may be in effect.

selected.description: The buyer's choice, by option id. It is the complete set in effect and replaces `included[]`.

before_reference.description: Default `P0D`. Measured from notice received to the `notice_reference` date, or to the `window.start` of the `dated_shares[]` entry that applies. The entry with the longest `before_reference` the notice meets applies; notice that meets none takes the shortest

calculation.description: `none` | `cancelled` | `commitment` | `fixed`. `none`: no fee. `cancelled`: `share` of the cancelled amount. `commitment`: `share` of `commitment.amount` without `delta_flat` charges, whatever has been delivered. `fixed`: `amount`

held_availability.description: What the hold reserves, as the seller states it on a grant or a re-offer. It can be less than `requested_terms` asks

position.description: Seller-set, 1 for first in line, in the order granted. A later hold moves up only when the one ahead expires, is released or converts. Holds on the same inventory reserve it in that order, so a later hold reserves only what the holds granted ahead of it leave (§ 5.6.1)

reference.description: Seller-set. The seller's id for the reservation, so a buyer can reconcile a hold against the seller's systems

requested_terms.description: The composition the buyer asks to hold, which is not a `commit`. A field it doesn't name reads as § 3.1 and § 3.2 put in effect

valid_until.description: The grant time plus `hold_terms.duration`, or the § 4.3.4 cap if that comes first. With no `duration`, the seller sets it within the cap. It MAY remain on `expired` and `released`

available.description: Whether this line item may be held

duration.description: How long a hold runs from its grant

dataset.description: The source's named data release the multipliers come from. A new release is a new `dataset`

impression_type.description: `gross` | `viewable` | `lts` | `audience`: Gross, Viewable (OTS), Likelihood-to-See, or Audience impressions, as the MRC Out-of-Home Measurement Standards (Phase 1 & 2 Combined, December 2025) define them

settles_on.description: `declared` | `restated`. `declared`: the value `dataset` gives that screen, or sync group, and hour when the play runs. Under a deal mechanism (§ 5.9), the bid request carries it as OpenRTB 2.6 `imp.qty.multiplier`. `restated`: that value after any reissue of `dataset` by its source before the count is final (§ 5.7.1)

source_type.description: Who supplies the multiplier. A value from AdCOM 1.0 List: DOOH Multiplier Measurement Source Types other than Unknown (`0`), such as Publisher Provided (`2`). The value OpenRTB 2.6 `imp.qty.sourcetype` carries

vendor.description: The domain of the vendor or exchange that supplies the multipliers, as OpenRTB 2.6 `imp.qty.vendor` names a vendor

audiences.description: The line item's `audiences`, projected to `selected[]`, `excluded[]`, and `combine.selected[]`.

buyer_requirements.description: The line item's `buyer_requirements`, projected to `seats` and `seat_owner`.

exclusions.description: The buyer's block lists, keyed by exclusion type. See below

notice_duration.description: The least time from the seller's notice to the first preempted delivery. Absent: no notice is owed

reason.description: What can preempt this line item. Core term: `exclusivity`, an exclusivity term the seller accepts later that holds, under its `separation` and `window`, where and when this line item delivers

remedy.description: What the buyer gets for the delivery a preemption takes, on any `delivery_type`. Core terms: `makegood` | `credit` | `none`, where `none` gives nothing for that delivery only. Absent: `shortfall_remedy` (§ 5.7) settles any shortfall the preemption causes

agreed_rate.description: The transacted rate (below). Absent on every other entry

cost_definition.description: Public definition of one unit and the `cost_parameters` keys (§ 5.6.5)

cost_method.description: The billable unit. Core terms in § 5.6.5

cost_parameters.description: The keys the term requires (§ 5.6.5). Absent when it requires none

currency.description: The currency of the entry's rates (below)

list_rate.description: The rate before options. A buyer MAY request another value, and a granted value is the `list_rate` of the next `version`

min_rate.description: A hint: the lowest `list_rate` the seller says it will consider. It grants nothing. Not a term, not the downstream auction floor, and never sent downstream

price_type.description: How `agreed_rate` clears, as Deals API 1.0 `terms.pricetype`: Dynamic (0), the auction type of each bid request; First Price (1); Second Price Plus (2); Fixed Price (3); or an exchange-specific value, 500 and up

price_valid_until.description: How long the entry holds (§ 4.3.2). Distinct from the proposal's `offer_window.end`

pricing_id.description: Names the entry within the line item. A revision MUST NOT reuse it for a different `cost_method`, `cost_parameters`, `currency`, or `transaction_mechanisms[]`

rate_per.description: `1` | `1000`. Units per rate. For a core term, the vocabulary sets it, and a present value MUST match

transaction_mechanisms.description: The `transaction_mechanism` options this entry prices. Absent: every offered option

unit_bounds.description: Bounds on the units committed under this entry, counted in its unit (§ 5.6.5): `commitment.amount` when `basis` is `units`, otherwise `derived_units`. A buyer MAY request another. Absent on a `FLAT` entry

unit_label.description: A short label for one unit, such as `engagement`

PricingEntryRatePer.description: The values of `LineItem.pricing[].rate_per` its row lists
PricingEntryRatePer.title: Pricing Entry Rate Per

evidence.description: What the buyer receives. Core terms: `play_log` | `photo` | `audit_report`

SpendRange.description: A range of values from `min` to `max`, with at least one bound, such as the time an ad stays in the content the seller distributes.

UnitBoundsRange.description: A range of values from `min` to `max`, with at least one bound, such as the time an ad stays in the content the seller distributes.

description: The OpenProposal `commercial` module: the vocabularies, objects, unions, and constructor copies of § 5.6, § 5.6.1, § 5.6.2, § 5.6.3, § 3.4, § 4.1.2, § 5.6.4, § 5.6.5, § 5.6.6, and § 5.6.7.
